reviews.author: Casey Smith
reviews.text: I can't tell you how wonderful the people here are. A long story short in one of the vehicles that I own. It has had some issues with overheating. When I went to get it looked at in Winston-Salem they charge me $40 just to cap off my coolant. They did no work and they didn't look at any of the other products. This was not the case here; they did it for free and looked to make sure that it was there and scheduled to follow up in order to look at it. More so instead of it taking 3 weeks in order to get an appointment to get brakes done, they were able to fit me in in a very quick period of time. The fine gentleman at the front counter often says the quote. I have to see the people who come here in the grocery store and I don't want to hide from them. Sometimes you hear these things and you think that they are just blowing smoke. That is certainly not the case here. They are phenomenal individuals and I'm glad that I stumbled across them.

reviews.author: Autumn Taylor
reviews.text: I called in to try and get my Volkswagen fixed and he said he didn’t specialize in my make. I truly value honesty and sincerity over anything - if I didn’t have a Volkswagen I would for sure trust this place to work on my vehicle! Thanks for the recommendations!
